w: For the successful completion of the Bhadra murti installation festival, a total of 2,225 male and female volunteers were at work in 23 departments. But in 1969, when Yogiji Maharaj installed the mandir right here, there was no such corps of volunteers. If you count a corps, it was Swamishri's faith in Shriji Maharaj, and if you count strength, it was Swamishri's unbroken devotion to Shriji Maharaj and his devotion to his guru, Yogiji Maharaj. A priceless record of Swamishri's hard work at that time is found on page after page of the diaries he himself wrote. This is a golden documentary page of history.
A few of those original pages are presented here as a memento. Swamishri's notes in his own handwriting are presented as they are, and the same details have also been typed and placed below them.

On 9 April 1969 Swamishri wrote: "In Jodiya we went to the bungalow of Hansrajbhai Sheth, the crafts industry, the taluka primary school, the girls' school, and also to Kasturchandbhai's place, and looked at them for accommodation."
In the same way, Swamishri also met the Thakor Saheb of Dhrol about accommodation and requested accommodation for the devotees in his rest house.
Writing about the time of the installation, on 22 April 1969, Swamishri noted in his diary:
"People came in their thousands. There was accommodation in the tents that had come from Gondal, accommodation in the village, accommodation in Jodiya and accommodation in Dhrol."
Recalling Swamishri's organising ability, Bhimjibhai says:

"The days of the festival had already begun. In the days before the installation, Swamishri himself was carrying the responsibility for everything, from the yagna to the assembly, the water and the electricity. Around that time, far more devotees than expected had come from other places. The rooms fixed for accommodation in the village of Bhadra could not hold everyone. In this situation, those who had come by motor vehicle were given accommodation in neighbouring villages, schools and dharmashalas. Even so, the rush of devotees was great. At such a time, while carrying other responsibilities, Swamishri calmly used 'whatever is at hand is the weapon'. The devotees were made to sleep in the assembly pandal at night. Devotees were made to sleep in the courtyards and lanes of the Patels. Sacking was brought out from the Patels' houses and spread in the lanes and courtyards. In this way the devotees rested in the courtyards and lanes throughout the village. Swamishri managed the festival in this way. He kept everyone happy."

In the evening assembly, Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored in the presence of Swamishri. During his blessings, Swamishri emphasized the need to conserve water in the prevailing drought that has gripped the region of Saurashtra: "Today, there is a severe crises of water. When the rains fail we realize the importance of water. And during the hot summer months we get anxious, criticize and angrily voice our opinions and even fight for water. But by merely shouting nothing is achieved. You have to think individually and act. There are some people in Saurashtra who are aware and active to the need for conserving water. It is time to unite and realize that we have to save water. If you endeavor to make arrangements for collecting water then it will benefit everyone. For the present don't waste water, use it judiciously…"
Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha rituals of murtis for the Swaminarayan Mandir for women in the village of Chachana.
Through mandirs one is inspired with dharma and faith in God.
When one understand mundane happiness as temporary, then one will not be desirous of them.

In the morning Swamishri arrived at Paliyad for the 'Amra Bapu Murti-Pratishtha Mahotsav.' First Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of a canvas murti of Amra Bapu in a mandir and then went to the 'Sadhus' Get Together' program. The inauguration of the entrance to the festival ground was performed by Swamishri and Jagadguru Shri Ramnareshacharyaji. Then both dignitaries kindled the inaugural lamp of the festival. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
At 6.30 p.m. Swamishri arrived at Lathi village where a public assembly was arranged on the diamond grounds of the renowned diamond businessman Shri Manji Rudabhai Dholakiya.

At 7.45 p.m. Swamishri arrived at the public satsang assembly in Amreli. Corporators of the local Amreli Municipality presented a citation of honor to Swamishri. An official of Rotary Club presented a citation of honor to Swamishri. On behalf of the Red Cross Society, Amreli, a philanthropist presented a citation of honor to Swamishri. Many other organizations of Amreli also welcomed and honored Swamishri. In his blessings Swamishri said, "Amreli is a blessed land. Formerly it was under the jurisdiction ofthe Gaekwad State and it introduced education on a compulsory basis. Many people have acquired good education and become scholars and citizens of character. Our importance lies in having character. Character is an asset. If character is lost then everything is lost..."
ph: Swamishri and Shri Ramnareshacharyaji perform the opening ceremony of the festival at the main entrance

w: Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Shri Radha-Krishna Dev, Shri Sita-Ram, Shri Shiv-Parvati, Shri Hanumanji and Shri Ganapatiji for the hari mandir in Deesa, and Shri Hanumanji and Shri Gana-patiji for the hari mandir in Visnagar.

During Pramukh Swami Maharaj's evening walk, for the Shri Hari festival, Shantmuni Swami gave a talk on "Niyamakaya namah" (salutations to the Controller) and Purnajivan Swami on "Svatantraya namah" (salutations to the Independent One) in English, and translated them too. While the talk "Svatantraya namah" was going on, it was time for the rest break in the middle of the walk. Swamishri sat on a chair. So Yogicharan Swami said, "Say a sentence."
"What shall I say?" Swamishri showed hesitation.
The sadhus said, "You are independent; say whatever you like."
Hearing this, Swamishri immediately said, "Where are we independent! We are subject to God. God alone is independent. He runs the whole system and keeps it going."
This unique devotion as a servant on the part of Swamishri touched everyone.

ds.t: No position like that of a sadhu
w: This evening, while Pramukh Swami Maharaj was seated for his meal, Aksharcharan Swami began introducing the activities of some sadhus and said, "You know this one, of course."
"No. I do not know anyone," Swamishri said with a straight face.
Hearing this, that sadhu said, "If you do not know me, how will I be liberated?"
"Then there will be trouble in that too!" With a smile Swamishri gave an unexpected answer. Everyone burst out laughing.
Then Swamishri began to say, "We know Ramchandra Kaka, we know his brother Bhailal, we also know Bhailal's son Kanaiyalal. Kanaiyalal means Kanu. We know his son Bhaskar. And you are his..."
When Swamishri, recalling four generations in this way, recounted the whole family line, everyone was astonished.

When that sadhu was a student doing higher studies in America, he had a wish in his mind that he too could become President of America. Referring to this, Swamishri said, "Now that you have come here, you have become president."
"How?"
"One who remembers Shriji Maharaj and takes His refuge, there is no one like him. After attaining God and the Sant, what remains? There is no position like that of a sadhu!"

A student studying in Class 10 came for darshan. He had fallen into the bad habit of misusing his mobile phone. Because of this habit he was slowly losing his concentration. Pramukh Swami Maharaj gently corrected him and said, "In life you must not fail, you must succeed. This wrong habit you have started now will trouble you all your life. So give all this up. Obey your parents. If you go down the wrong path, your life will be spoiled, so for now pay attention to your studies. Study properly. Do five malas and pray, so that all these habits leave you."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj gave his blessings to a young man named Brijrajsinh. Near his village, a small boy had slipped 25 feet down into a wide borewell. The fire brigade came, but there was no way they could get the boy out. So the firemen said to the crowd that had gathered around to watch, "Let one of you come here. We will tie ropes to his feet and lower him head first 25 feet, so that he can hold the boy's hands and bring him up." No one standing in the crowd was willing. The satsangi youth Brijrajsinh happened to be passing by. He saw that "a life can be saved," so he came forward himself. He went head first into the 25-foot-deep borewell, which was very narrow, rescued the boy and brought him out. He did this brave act purely through Swamishri's spiritual strength, and even the newspapers reported it. Swamishri was very pleased and gave him his blessings.
In the evening, after his walk, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was sitting on a chair to rest. The sadhus were sitting in front.
Dr Kiran said, "When the white doctors in Atlanta came to meet you, they were amazed at such good health at 90!!"

Swamishri immediately said, "How many devotees do chanting, austerities, vows and prayers! Some do dharna parna, some go on walking pilgrimages. All this becomes blessings, and so, my dear brother, it goes on."
Narayancharan Swami said, "Please listen to the austerities and vows of all these people and their prayers for your good health."
Swamishri said, "God listens. That is why everything exists and goes on by his grace and compassion."

Brahmavihari Swami said, "At 90, people cannot even speak properly! When they see the way you work, many are amazed. Yogeshbhai Lakhani came to the inauguration of the show. He is a very big lawyer. He said, 'The blessings Pramukh Swami gave continuously at this age, and the clarity in them too, were truly wonderful.'"

Then, as talk turned to the water show, Brahmavihari Swami said, "Whoever has seen the water show gives a very wonderful opinion. You have put power and divinity into it, and this is its effect. If anyone else tried to do this, they simply could not."
Swamishri was listening to this in silence, so Brahmavihari Swami said, "Isn't that right? Please say something."
Swamishri said, "What is there to say in that?"
Swamishri did not say anything, so the conversation went on.
Dr Kiranbhai Doshi said, "Doing this at the age of 90 also takes courage."
Brahmavihari Swami said, "And then fifty problems come, and they all land on your chest."
Swamishri said, "It is all God's courage. He is seated in this chest, and so the work gets done."
Brahmavihari Swami said, "However many problems come, not even a line on your face changes. Even when we come with problems, after hearing them you remain just as calm."

Swamishri said, "It is like this! All together, the cart moves. The devotees and the sadhus are all like that. Their dedication is like that too. In the time of Shriji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj there was the same dedication. So, my dear brother, the work gets done."
Swamishri remained completely untouched by all the credit.

In the middle of his walk, Pramukh Swami Maharaj does exercises. Now, as the exercises began, the sadhus sitting in front spoke about some proud moments of the BAPS organisation. Swamishri was listening.

As soon as the exercises were over, Swamishri said from the depth of his heart, "Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj laid deep roots for the organisation. Even a two year old child has a spirit of dedication; otherwise, who would go to explain it to him? Everyone, young and old, has feeling from within. Everyone dedicates themselves to the organisation."
In between, Yogicharan Swami spoke about some other people who had said that what the BAPS organisation has done, we could never do.

In this very context Swamishri said, "Here, everyone, young and old, has only one thought: to do something for the organisation. Outside, the officers meet and then go their separate ways, so how can work get done? This is the wish of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj, so everyone, young and old, feels that this work must be done well. Dedication in every way, dedication with the body and dedication with wealth. Children save their pocket money and give it here, feeling that they must do the work of this organisation. In those other places, the officers come, look and go their separate ways. But here there is great depth. Everyone has feeling, everyone has dedication. It is in the soul of everyone, young and old, and so the work gets done. It is God's grace, so there is feeling in everyone's soul. It is also the grace of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj, so the work gets done."
Brahmavihari Swami said, "Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj are in you too, aren't they?"
Swamishri said, "They are, and that is why everything happens through them! The knowledge of Akshar Purushottam spreads in everyone and the work gets done."
Swamishri slipped into singing the praises of everyone's dedication, sacrifice, devotion and conviction.

Today, when Mahant Swami Maharaj's breakfast was over, the attendant sadhu had almost lifted the plate away. Just then, pointing to the fafda (a crisp gram flour snack) lying at the corner of the table, Swamishri said, "This is left."
Everyone was surprised, because Swamishri never himself shows a liking to eat any dish. Today, since Swamishri himself showed a liking, everyone was pleased. Swamishri ate a little fafda.

Just then Pradipbhai came in, and Gunvatsaldas Swami revealed the secret, saying, "As I was coming in with the plate, Pradipbhai had told me, 'Feed the master (Swamishri) fafda.' You caught his wish and asked for the fafda yourself and ate it."

Hearing this, Pradipbhai was choked with emotion. And on top of that, Swamishri gave Pradipbhai some of that fafda as prasad with his own hand and, while he watched, ate some again himself. Tears of devotion flowed from Pradipbhai's eyes.
